_note: Adhoc scene (script-standard §14): a small custom-styled 'a moment to spare' card with its own layout/interactions, rendered by a developer-supplied module. `fullscreen` makes it an immersive viewport takeover (past the letterbox, player chrome hidden). `call`ed from s01_classroom before the lunch choice; its result writes aoi_affection back into the flow. The `stay` exit returns to resume s01; the `slip_away` exit jumps to s01's #leave branch. `fallback` keeps the game completable on any runtime that can't run the module.
